50647760.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to eEF1A1 expressed in human MDA-MB-231 cells using 1 uM biotinylated compound immobilized on streptavidin sensor chip by surface plasmon resonance method

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) Analysis. One micromolar of biotinylated compounds 10, 24, and 39 in Biacore HBS-EP buffer were individually immobilized on 3 of the 4 flow cells on a streptavidin sensor chip (Biacore SA Chip) at 5 μL/min for 10 min each. The remaining one empty flow cell was assigned as a reference flow cell and was immobilized with Linker-Lysin-Biotin only. eEF1A1 and GST were 2-fold serial diluted in HBS-EP buffer from 100 nM to 6.25 nM. The protein at each concentration was injected at 30 μL/min for 3 min and dissociated for 5 min. K_on, K_off, and K_D were evaluated by using BioEvaluation software to fit binding curves with proper binding models.

data_analysis.reference_description: Empty flow cell immobilized with Linker-Lysin-Biotin only
